Alex M: Quick heads-up 11 we need a 2-hr paid search sprint tomorrow AM to support the webinar registration push. Objective: keep CPC stable, avoid runaway spend. :eyes:
Priya S: Copy. Plan: swap retarget creative or scale current winners?
Alex M: Swap creative for retarget pool B, and small scale on top 3 performing keywords only. Pacing guard: daily cap + 20% burst for first 2 hours, then throttle back to baseline. :rocket:
Sam R: I can push the creative swap and update ad copy. Send creative IDs and exact UTM.
Alex M: Creative IDs are C-9812 and C-9813. New ad copy includes webinar CTA + urgency. Please append this UTM to the final URL:
?utm_source=paid_search&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_may&utm_content=creative_B
Jonas L: I'll build a compact dashboard for the first-hour pacing. Triggers: CTR drop >20% or CPA >2x baseline -> auto-fallback to previous creative. Will post link when ready.
Maya C: QA checklist: landing variant B must have updated CTA and thank-you mapped to /webinar-thanks-v2. I'll run a quick smoke test pre-launch.
Priya S: Adding a 3hr pacing rule: if spend reaches 80% of hourly target before 45m, throttle keyword bids by -15%. Anyone object?
Sam R: No objections. Scheduling swap at 09:00 PST, 60s precheck at 08:58. @deploy-bot can you post a reminder? :bell:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 1 see you at 08:58 PST, will ping @Priya S @Sam R @Alex M in #marketing.
Alex M: Jonas 1 can you route alert to #marketing-ops if CPA spikes?
Jonas L: Done 1 webhook -> #marketing-ops. Also added an anomaly detector: if CTR drops >15% vs baseline we mute new creative and notify.
Maya C: QA done on staging. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/snap12345 (looks clean).
Priya S: Uploading assets to the manager now. Tagging creatives and setting pacing caps.
Sam R: Creative swap is in draft and will go live on schedule.
Alex M: Thanks all. Post-launch sync at 09:15 for a 15-min readout. Drop updates here. :thumbsup:
